after.r2193_iron_gpr_evidence: Two Y. lipolytica FET3/FTR1 pairs. D09 (YALI1D09277g, YALI1D09308g): reciprocal best hits of S. cerevisiae FET3 and FTR1. D08 (YALI1D08684g, YALI1D08564g): their paralogs, whose best S. cerevisiae hits are also FET3 and FTR1 (one-way). Pfam and KEGG support both pairs; all four proteins are detected in Debiaggi 2025 proteomics. Co-expression of YALI1D08564g with Vitreoscilla hemoglobin raised intracellular iron (Ye et al. 2026; no Ftr1-only control). AND within a pair follows the S. cerevisiae Fet3-Ftr1 complex (Stearman et al. 1996, PMID 8599111).
after.r2193_iron_gpr_evidence_tier: orthology (reciprocal for the D09 pair, one-way for the D08 paralogs) and protein detection; same-species co-expression evidence for YALI1D08564g only; not Y. lipolytica biochemistry
after.r2193_iron_gpr_known_limit: Both D09-pair genes are on the consensus essential list; this OR rule cannot express that the D08 pair does not compensate.
